usageNotes: Deletes a resource pool by poolid using the legacy path-param form; prefer 'DELETE /pools/?poolid={poolid}' for environments with nested pool support. The pool must be empty — remove all member VMs, CTs, and storage entries before calling. Requires the Pool.Allocate privilege on /pool/{poolid}.
destructiveReason: Permanently removes the pool object and its ACL entries; any access-control rules scoped to this pool are lost and cannot be recovered.
tips: This endpoint is marked deprecated — use DELETE /pools with poolid as a query parameter when nested pools are in use.
If the pool still has members the API returns an error; use GET /pools/{poolid} to list and remove members first.
Returns null on success — no task UPID is issued, so the deletion is synchronous.
